title: MSFS Marketplace Update: Lufthansa 747 100 Years & New Schedules
description:
This week’s Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update for April 26, 2026 is packed with must-have new releases for PC simmers, featuring highly anticipated international activities like the Lufthansa 100th Anniversary missions and refreshed airline schedules from Delhi to Lisbon alongside immersive new regional challenges you’ll want in your hangar.  

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activities (missions & schedules) were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Perfect Flight: 100 Years of Lufthansa - B747 Edition (12 ultra-realistic missions & centennial livery)
🗺️ VA Systems: Airline Schedules - Winter 2025 Series (Alaska, SpiceJet, Air Astana, Finnair)
🗺️ VA Systems: Airport Schedules - Winter 2025 Series (Lisbon, Delhi, Casablanca, Quito, Charlotte)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: Advanced Challenges - Spain Landings (16 precision landing challenges)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: 8 Legs World Tour Challenge (A legendary journey across the globe)
